reden: Yes. The audit report’s High finding explicitly targets Liquidate.executeLiquidate(), where liquidatorReward is computed as min(assignedCollateral - debtInCollateralToken, mulDivUp(debtPosition.futureValue, ...)). It points out the unit/decimals mismatch: the first term is in collateral-token units while the second uses futureValue in borrow-token units, causing the reward to be far too small and removing liquidation incentives. It recommends deriving the reward from debtInCollateralToken or converting to collateral units—the same fix proposed in the vulnerability description (use debtInCollateralToken in the percentage calculation). Same function, same code path, same root cause, and same fix; thus the report detected the described vulnerability.
